entries.title: The Sinking City
entries.definitive_edition: The Sinking City Remastered Deluxe Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC remaster rather than emulating console versions.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Unreal Engine 5 remaster with PC settings and capture flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC Remastered Deluxe route is the strongest main playthrough because the remaster rebuilds the game in Unreal Engine 5 with relit environments and enhanced visuals, while the Deluxe bundle keeps the story DLC and bonus packs on the same high-fidelity PC route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Sinking City Remastered Deluxe Edition on PC through Steam, Epic, or GOG. Install the included story DLC, then play the remastered PC build as the full run.

entries.remaster_caveats: The 2025 remaster is the preferred new-playthrough route; older original releases remain historically separate, and the game previously had delisting/publisher-dispute complications before Frogwares became sole publisher.
